title: STEWARDSHIP
mv: Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.
mvp: “Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.’’ 1Corinthians 4:2
assignment: List five (5) areas of life where a believer is called to be a faithful steward (2X5=10 marks).

b.x: The dictionary defines stewardship as the responsible and careful management of something entrusted to one’s care. As Christians, God has entrusted so many things in our care and He expects us to be careful managers of everything in our account (Luke 16:10). Today, some have suddenly become so comfortable that they handle kingdom business carelessly. We must remember that we are not owners, but caretakers of God's resources (Psalm 24:1).
Being a good steward of God’s resources requires certain characteristics and virtues.

i: Trust: As believers, we must be trustworthy in everything. A person who is trustworthy in little things will be entrusted with greater responsibilities (1 Peter 4:10; Luke 16:10).
Obedience: We must make sure our obedience is complete and timely (John 2:5).
Wisdom: Correct application of knowledge will help avoid wastage (Luke 12:42).
Humility: Humility helps us to focus our hearts on God, seeking His glory alone (John 3:30).
Compassion and Giving: A steward must be generous, be willing to share with those in need and support God's work (Hebrews 13:16; 1 Peter 3:8).
Diligence: A steward must work hard because laziness leads to unfruitfulness (Proverbs 22:29).

b.x: As a faithful steward, you should expect numerous rewards here on earth and in the world to come (Matthew 19:29).

i: Spiritual Growth and Strength: A steward that is faithful will grow spiritually and bring glory to God (2 Peter 3:18).
Divine Guidance: God promises to personally instruct and lead His children in the right path (Psalm 32:8).
Promotion and Increase: Faithfulness in small responsibilities brings greater opportunities and honour from God (Matthew 25:23).
Answered Prayers: God answers the prayers of those who are faithful, granting them favour and fulfilment (Psalm 91:14-16).

God's approval and praise: God rewards faithfulness with His approval, commendation and acknowledges diligence. This divine praise leads to greater responsibility and everlasting joy in His presence (Matthew 25:20-21).

Eternal rewards and blessings: Those who remain faithful to Christ, even in trials, will share in His reign and glory. Serving God wholeheartedly guarantees eternal rewards and blessings that surpass earthly gains (2 Timothy 2:12; Colossians 3:23-24).

b.x: A good steward reflects good and godly character.

i: What are the rewards for stewardship?
